lines.text: Huh? Pokémon?\nOh! No, this is a hotel for people.\c\nAnd we’re full up, unfortunately.
I came here on vacation with my brother and\nmy boyfriend—just the three of us.\c\nIsn’t Celadon a beautiful city?
Why?\nWhy did she bring her brother along, too?
Yippee! I’m on vacation!\nMy sis brought me along! She’s the best!
